summary: Delivered specimens as prose descriptions because no render capability is reachable from this phase. Reported one eligibility blocker on Direction C (280vh of scroll against a 30-second decision task) since gate direction-eligibility has no executor.

claims.claim: The specimens are prose descriptions, not renders; hierarchy, composition and typography cannot be assessed from them.
Direction C has a structural conflict with the product task: 280vh of scroll for a surface whose job is a 30-second decision.
Gate direction-eligibility was not executed by any mechanism; this Handoff reports the blocker instead.

risks: The tournament that follows will compare prose, so its verdict measures argumentation quality, not visual quality.
All three specimens share one author, so anonymization in the tournament cannot work as designed.
unresolved: direction-eligibility has no executor; the blocker on Direction C is reported but not enforced
